title: Speaking Practice 1 - Hometown & Travel
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Questions about your hometown and travel experiences.

stimuli.title: Part 1: Hometown & Travel
stimuli.content: In this part, the examiner will ask you questions about yourself and familiar topics. Answer each question in 2-3 sentences.

questionGroups.instruction: Answer the following questions about your hometown.

explanation.sampleAnswer: My hometown is Ho Chi Minh City, which is the largest city in Vietnam. It's located in the southern part of the country.
explanation.tips: Give specific details about location and briefly describe it

questions.content: What do you like most about your hometown?

explanation.sampleAnswer: What I love most is the vibrant street food culture. You can find delicious and affordable food on almost every corner.
explanation.tips: Express a clear preference and give a reason

questions.content: Has your hometown changed much in recent years?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, it has changed dramatically. Many new skyscrapers and shopping malls have been built, and the metro system is now under construction.
explanation.tips: Use present perfect tense and give specific examples of changes

explanation.sampleAnswer: Absolutely, I'm passionate about travelling. I try to visit at least one new place every year because I find it really enriching.

questions.content: What was the last place you visited?

explanation.sampleAnswer: The last place I visited was Da Nang, a coastal city in central Vietnam. I went there last summer for a short holiday with my friends.
explanation.tips: Use past simple tense and provide specific details

questions.content: Do you prefer travelling alone or with others?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I generally prefer travelling with friends because it's more fun to share experiences. However, I sometimes enjoy solo trips when I want some quiet time.
explanation.tips: State preference clearly and give balanced reasoning
